text.description_html:
Fusion RH-T7, Blue Ridge Wall Mounted Robe Hook

The Blue Ridge Robe Hook is easy to install and comes with all the necessary mounting hardware. Choose from 3 finishes: antique relic pewter, medium relic bronze, and dark rustic bronze finishes, each of which only adds to its rustic charm. Made by Fusion hardware, the RH-T7 hook can be used for so much more than hanging your bath robe. Add a few to your closet for purses and scarves or even put one near the front door for your hat.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TR-T7 Blue Ridge Towel Ring, Fusion TB-T7 Blue Ridge Towel Bar, and Fusion PH-T7 Blue Ridge Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion American Relic Series Robe Hook:

  • Mount Width: 2-3/4"
  • Mount Length: 4-1/4"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
